description: TfL publishes river-service routes with frequency, operator, service type and status attributes. In this representation, route lines connect the beginning and end piers and are positioned for cartographic clarity. The source references a July 2017 update. Geometry should therefore not be assumed to follow the complete travelled path or all intermediate stops. A separate provider layer connects routes to individual pier locations and is retained as a distinct representation. Coverage is Greater London. Access is through the published ArcGIS feature service. Licence and cost: The source states UK Open Government Licence (OGL). Caveats: only item, service and layer metadata were inspected. No feature records were downloaded, and current completeness, geometric quality and operational availability remain untested. Access charges are not stated in the inspected metadata. The resource provides mapped infrastructure or service inputs; applying it in a simulation requires checking the source limits and relevant model assumptions. Related resources include the existing TfL 2023 PTAL grid.
